svg.title: How the two jobs share the runs
svg.desc: run-all.sh splits the runs of the suite into two shards, one for each required check, which runs its runs side by side on a runner of its own. Shard 1, the check nextcloud, holds the oldest and the newest supported version; shard 2, the check nextcloud on PostgreSQL, MariaDB and S3, holds the newest version on PostgreSQL and on MariaDB with S3, when the change can behave differently there, and the upgrade from the last release, when the change can break it. Each version between goes, from the oldest, to the shard with the lighter load, where a version with its browser checks counts as two runs and a variant as one, and to shard 2 when both weigh as much. With Nextcloud 33 to 35, shard 1 runs 33 and 35 and shard 2 runs 34 and the variants.
